messages:
lee: heads-up: sudden spike in pending GPU pods in edge-az-3 starting ~08:20 UTC, saw pending climb 10 -> 75
maya: saw it on the dashboard, started at 08:19. most pending are tiny gpu:1 jobs.
ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted +4 nodes in edge-az-3; 2 failed (quota), 2 provisioned after long startup.
lee: quota failures surprising — we had margin friday. could be spot pool quota burned by another region spill.
tim: scheduler logs show lots of TolerationsNotMatching for taint reserved=true:NoSchedule; tiny jobs don't tolerate it and are left scattered.
maya: also tenant anti-affinity set to avoid co-locating tenant workloads; combined with reserved taint this leaves single-slot holes.
anil: we rolled a soft-reserve taint yesterday to protect large, long-running jobs. did that change flip in edge-az-3 only? @sara
sara: rolled reserve taint cluster-wide but edge-az-3 had more long jobs so effects amplified.
lee: hypothesis: reserve taint + tenant anti-affinity + spot quota = pocketing. tiny pods won't pack into nodes with reserved taint.
maya: scheduler binpack score is getting negated by hard anti-affinity constraints and filter rejects.
ops-bot: sample filter log:
```
I1009 08:22:11 scheduler_pred: pod small-x rejected: TolerationsNotMatching(taint reserved=true:NoSchedule)
I1009 08:22:18 score: node n-edge3-04 binpack=9 spread=2
```
tim: mitigation options:
- relax taint to PreferNoSchedule
- inject toleration for tiny class via mutating webhook
- kick on-demand fallback for AZ to bypass spot quota
lee: short-term prefer on-demand fallback to serve customers; accept cost hit.
maya: agree for short window. also lower anti-affinity weight to encourage co-location for tiny pods for 1 hour.
anil: I'll stand up an incident runbook entry and capture exact timing for rollback.
sara: can flip taint to PreferNoSchedule in ~5m if greenlit.
ops-bot: Finance impact forecast queued: estimated delta $1.6k/hr if we use 10 on-demand GPUs in eu-west3 region for fallback.
finance-bot: finance notified.
lee: go ahead with on-demand fallback and taint flip. tim, can you add the webhook to inject toleration for label workload-size=small for 30m?
tim: webhook rule added at 08:30 UTC, TTL 30m, injecting toleration reserved=true:NoSchedule -> tolerated.
ops-bot: taint preference change deployed to 8 nodes in edge-az-3 at 08:28 UTC.
maya: pending count fell from 75 -> 9 in ~12m after combined mitigations.
lee: watch eviction metrics — set short eviction-grace to 10m to avoid immediate eviction of long jobs.
anil: opened incident ticket INF-2026-112 with logs, scheduler profiles, and node events.
sara: post-incident actions:
- evaluate per-AZ taint rollout instead of cluster-wide (sara)
- audit tenant anti-affinity defaults and lower defaults for tiny pods (product infra)
- review spot quota monitoring and cross-AZ spillover policy (cloudops)
- cost review of on-demand fallback (finance)
- ensure webhook removal after 30m (tim)
lee: thanks team. keeping thread open for any reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
